comment: Replicated for claim P-0034-c1 (A-A pair at rest, r0 in [3.0, 3.5], T <= 1) only. Three in-domain A-A runs, each two particles at rest, judged RMSE/L against the paper's predict(): 2026-11-26/r1/lab-b/006 (r0 3.25, T 1.0) 0.00475; 007 (r0 3.50, T 1.0) 0.00485; 2026-11-18/r2/lab-b/010 (r0 3.00, T 1.0) 0.00498. Bar 3 x 0.007 = 0.021. All three pass; 006 and 007 are out of sample for this paper. Power caveat: at T = 1 the zero-force nulls are 0.017 (006), 0.015 (007) and 0.021 (010). So these runs show consistency with the node values to the judge's noise floor, not precision at the few-percent level in K. Claim P-0034-c2 (C-C) is not covered by this verdict. I filed C-C runs 2026-11-26/r1/lab-b/008 (r0 3.0, 0.00469) and 009 (r0 3.5, 0.00473), both in domain and within the bar, but two runs is below the three-run bar, so I do not cite them as evidence for c2. Not tested: the supersession of P-0014 as a statement about that domain, r0 at 2.5 (contact inside T = 1), T above 1, and any shape finer than a few percent in K.
